stick.gimbal.name: Stick (roll / pitch)
stick.gimbal.note: grip shaft at the gimbal slot, X roll / Y pitch

source: JoyPro curated on the maker's photo (2026-10-11), Cyber Taurus E.B.82 FFB base without grip seen from the front-left and above, grip shaft with its quick-release collar at the upper left
mappingSource: WinWing Cyber Taurus joystick base manual (CT.JB, covers E.B.29 / E.B.82 / E.D.16): X = roll, Y = pitch 0-65535; the base itself has no buttons (power button, emergency stop and expansion ports only) (https://eu.winctrl.com/static/ipfs/QmPeEHsVbPU2BfDBwXPwzQwoVGrafx6ZsvGdxBVS5WGF8b); catalog winwing.json identify.note
note: Only the gimbal is a control; grip buttons come from the grip mounted on the collar. The marker sits on the shaft where it leaves the gimbal slot.
